goal: Build a Python CLI tool that calculates freelancer profit, tax, and effective hourly rate from a CSV of transactions, handling edge cases like zero hours and malformed rows.
acceptance_criteria: CLI accepts input CSV path via --input flag.
Tool calculates and displays Business Income, Expenses, Taxable Income, Tax Amount, Net Profit, and Effective Hourly Rate.
Handles zero/negative hours gracefully without division-by-zero errors.
Skips malformed/missing rows without crashing the tool.
Outputs a clean, formatted terminal report.
